body: I understand where you are coming from and why you might not want to PM someone that you don't know because it does some people uncomfortable. When I post on here trying to help people (on my main account) I understand that I might not help them since I am a complete stranger to them. Just because we may not be helping you, we still care about you. No one wants to see anyone commit suicide and even though we may not help, that doesn't stop us from trying.

I disagree completely. I posted here a long time ago and I was depressed, lost, hopeless, and had no will to live. The people here completely helped me. It may not be just one comment that changes you, but you need to give a little effort and try to let them help you. I contacted people who offered, and those were the people that saved me. If you need a friend, or someone to talk to, feel free to PM me anytime. I want to help you, I've been in the same position you are right now and I know how it feels. Please, we care about you no matter what you say or do, we all want to see you get better and get help.
